## 1. Data Loading and Cleaning

```{r load-data}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

DATA_PATH <- "/root/.claude/uploads/7e325fe5-5704-55cc-9ede-a4a3bdde6097/4372d09e-Participation_Constructs.xlsx"

df_raw <- read_excel(DATA_PATH)
cat("Columns:", paste(names(df_raw), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_raw), "\n")

# Helper: find column by partial name match (case-insensitive)
find_col <- function(df, keyword) {
  idx <- grep(keyword, names(df), ignore.case=TRUE, value=FALSE)
  if (length(idx) > 0) names(df)[idx[1]] else NA_character_
}

col_q22     <- find_col(df_raw, "q22")
col_info    <- find_col(df_raw, "info")
col_consult <- find_col(df_raw, "consult")
col_q24     <- find_col(df_raw, "q24")
col_sat     <- find_col(df_raw, "sat")
col_flag    <- find_col(df_raw, "flag")

cat("Mapped: q22=", col_q22, " info=", col_info, " consult=", col_consult,
    " q24=", col_q24, " sat=", col_sat, " flag=", col_flag, "\n")

# Rename and subset
df <- df_raw
rename_vec <- c()
if (!is.na(col_q22))     rename_vec[col_q22]     <- "q22"
if (!is.na(col_info))    rename_vec[col_info]     <- "info_score"
if (!is.na(col_consult)) rename_vec[col_consult]  <- "consult_score"
if (!is.na(col_q24))     rename_vec[col_q24]      <- "q24"
if (!is.na(col_sat))     rename_vec[col_sat]       <- "satisfaction"
if (!is.na(col_flag))    rename_vec[col_flag]      <- "flag"

df <- df_raw %>% rename(any_of(rename_vec))

# Remove flag==1 rows
if ("flag" %in% names(df)) {
  before_n <- nrow(df)
  df <- df %>% filter(flag != 1 | is.na(flag))
  cat("Removed", before_n - nrow(df), "flagged rows.\n")
  df <- df %>% select(-flag)
}

# Keep only relevant columns that exist
keep_cols <- intersect(c("q22","info_score","consult_score","q24","satisfaction"), names(df))
df <- df %>% select(all_of(keep_cols))

# Coerce to numeric
df <- df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

# Convert q24 to ordered factor, satisfaction to numeric
if ("q24" %in% names(df)) {
  df$q24_num <- df$q24
  df$q24 <- factor(df$q24, levels=sort(unique(df$q24, na.rm=TRUE)), ordered=TRUE)
}
if ("satisfaction" %in% names(df)) {
  df$satisfaction <- as.numeric(df$satisfaction)
}

df_complete <- df %>% drop_na()

cat("Complete cases:", nrow(df_complete), "\n")
head(df_complete)
```

## 2. Helper Function

```{r helper}
qtable <- function(x, caption="") {
  knitr::kable(x, caption=caption, digits=3)
}
```

## 3. Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptives}
library(knitr)

num_vars <- c("q22","info_score","consult_score","q24_num","satisfaction")
num_vars <- intersect(num_vars, names(df_complete))

desc_list <- lapply(num_vars, function(v) {
  x <- df_complete[[v]]
  x_clean <- x[!is.na(x)]
  data.frame(
    Variable  = v,
    N         = length(x_clean),
    Mean      = mean(x_clean),
    Median    = median(x_clean),
    SD        = sd(x_clean),
    Min       = min(x_clean),
    Max       = max(x_clean),
    Skewness  = if (requireNamespace("e1071", quietly=TRUE)) e1071::skewness(x_clean) else NA,
    Kurtosis  = if (requireNamespace("e1071", quietly=TRUE)) e1071::kurtosis(x_clean) else NA
  )
})
desc_df <- do.call(rbind, desc_list)
qtable(desc_df, caption="Descriptive Statistics")
```

## 4. lavaan Path Analysis

```{r lavaan-path}
library(lavaan)

if (all(c("q24_num","satisfaction") %in% names(df_complete))) {
  # Single-indicator path model with residual variances fixed to 0
  model_lav <- "
    # Measurement model (single indicators, fix residuals to 0)
    PST =~ satisfaction
    PL  =~ q24_num

    # Fix residual variances to 0 (single indicator assumption)
    satisfaction ~~ 0*satisfaction
    q24_num      ~~ 0*q24_num

    # Structural path
    PST ~ PL
  "

  fit_lav <- sem(model_lav, data=df_complete, estimator="ML")
  summary(fit_lav, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

  # Extract parameters
  params <- parameterestimates(fit_lav, standardized=TRUE)
  structural_params <- params[params$op == "~", ]
  qtable(structural_params[, c("lhs","op","rhs","est","se","z","pvalue","std.all")],
         caption="lavaan Path Coefficients (PST ~ PL)")

  fit_indices <- fitMeasures(fit_lav, c("cfi","rmsea","srmr","chisq","df","pvalue"))
  cat("\nFit indices:\n")
  print(fit_indices)
} else {
  cat("Required variables (q24_num, satisfaction) not found.\n")
}
```

## 5. Ordinal Logistic Regression (polr)

```{r ordinal-polr}
library(MASS)

if (all(c("q24_num","satisfaction") %in% names(df_complete))) {
  df_polr <- df_complete %>%
    mutate(sat_ord = ordered(satisfaction))

  polr_fit <- polr(sat_ord ~ q24_num, data=df_polr, Hess=TRUE)
  polr_summary <- summary(polr_fit)

  # Coefficient table with p-values
  ctable <- coef(polr_summary)
  p_vals <- pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail=FALSE) * 2
  polr_table <- cbind(ctable, "p value" = p_vals)
  qtable(polr_table, caption="Ordinal Logistic Regression (polr): sat_ord ~ q24_num")

  # Odds ratios
  or_table <- exp(cbind(OR=coef(polr_fit), confint(polr_fit)))
  qtable(or_table, caption="Odds Ratios and 95% CI")
} else {
  cat("Required variables not found.\n")
}
```

## 6. Ceiling Effect Diagnostics

```{r ceiling-effects}
library(ggplot2)

if ("satisfaction" %in% names(df_complete)) {
  sat_vec <- df_complete$satisfaction

  prop_max <- mean(sat_vec == max(sat_vec, na.rm=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE)
  cat("Proportion at maximum (", max(sat_vec, na.rm=TRUE), "):", round(prop_max, 4), "\n")
  cat("Proportion at 4 or 5:", round(mean(sat_vec >= 4, na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")

  # Histogram
  sat_df_plot <- data.frame(satisfaction=sat_vec)
  p_ceil <- ggplot(sat_df_plot, aes(x=satisfaction)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="steelblue", color="white", alpha=0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=max(sat_vec, na.rm=TRUE), color="red", linetype="dashed", linewidth=1) +
    annotate("text", x=max(sat_vec, na.rm=TRUE)-0.2, y=Inf,
             label=paste0("Ceiling: ", round(prop_max*100,1), "%"),
             hjust=1, vjust=1.5, color="red", size=4) +
    labs(title="Satisfaction Distribution with Ceiling Effect",
         x="Satisfaction Score", y="Count") +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p_ceil)

  # Chi-square test: compare observed vs uniform distribution
  obs_counts <- table(sat_vec)
  n_cats <- length(obs_counts)
  expected <- rep(sum(obs_counts)/n_cats, n_cats)
  chi_res <- chisq.test(obs_counts, p=rep(1/n_cats, n_cats))
  cat("\nChi-square test (vs uniform):\n")
  print(chi_res)
  qtable(data.frame(
    Statistic = c("Chi-squared", "df", "p-value"),
    Value = c(round(chi_res$statistic, 4), chi_res$parameter, round(chi_res$p.value, 4))
  ), caption="Chi-square Test: Satisfaction vs Uniform Distribution")
} else {
  cat("satisfaction column not found.\n")
}
```

## 7. Jonckheere-Terpstra Test

```{r jonckheere}
if (all(c("q24_num","satisfaction") %in% names(df_complete))) {
  jt_available <- requireNamespace("clinfun", quietly=TRUE)

  if (jt_available) {
    library(clinfun)
    jt_groups <- df_complete$q24_num
    jt_y      <- df_complete$satisfaction
    jt_result <- jonckheere.test(jt_y, jt_groups, alternative="increasing", nperm=999)
    cat("Jonckheere-Terpstra test (clinfun):\n")
    print(jt_result)
    qtable(data.frame(
      Statistic = c("JT statistic", "p-value"),
      Value = c(round(jt_result$statistic, 2), round(jt_result$p.value, 4))
    ), caption="Jonckheere-Terpstra Test Results")
  } else {
    cat("clinfun not available. Using manual implementation.\n")

    # Manual Jonckheere-Terpstra
    groups_jt <- sort(unique(df_complete$q24_num))
    group_data_jt <- lapply(groups_jt, function(g) df_complete$satisfaction[df_complete$q24_num == g])
    names(group_data_jt) <- as.character(groups_jt)

    J_stat <- 0
    for (i in seq_along(groups_jt)) {
      for (j in seq_along(groups_jt)) {
        if (j > i) {
          u_res <- wilcox.test(group_data_jt[[i]], group_data_jt[[j]],
                               alternative="less", exact=FALSE)
          J_stat <- J_stat + u_res$statistic
        }
      }
    }

    ns_jt <- sapply(group_data_jt, length)
    N_jt  <- sum(ns_jt)
    E_J   <- (N_jt^2 - sum(ns_jt^2)) / 4
    Var_J <- (N_jt^2 * (2*N_jt+3) - sum(ns_jt^2 * (2*ns_jt+3))) / 72
    Z_JT  <- (J_stat - E_J) / sqrt(Var_J)
    p_JT  <- pnorm(Z_JT, lower.tail=FALSE)

    cat(sprintf("Manual JT: J=%.2f, E(J)=%.2f, Z=%.4f, p=%.4f\n", J_stat, E_J, Z_JT, p_JT))
    qtable(data.frame(
      Statistic = c("J", "E(J)", "Var(J)", "Z", "p-value (one-tailed)"),
      Value = c(round(J_stat,2), round(E_J,2), round(Var_J,2), round(Z_JT,4), round(p_JT,4))
    ), caption="Manual Jonckheere-Terpstra Test")
  }
} else {
  cat("Required variables not found.\n")
}
```

## 8. Mediation Analysis: info_score -> q24 -> satisfaction

```{r mediation}
if (all(c("info_score","q24_num","satisfaction") %in% names(df_complete))) {

  med_available <- requireNamespace("mediation", quietly=TRUE)

  if (med_available) {
    library(mediation)

    # Mediator model: q24_num ~ info_score
    med_model <- lm(q24_num ~ info_score, data=df_complete)

    # Outcome model: satisfaction ~ q24_num + info_score
    out_model <- lm(satisfaction ~ q24_num + info_score, data=df_complete)

    cat("Mediator model summary:\n")
    print(summary(med_model))
    cat("\nOutcome model summary:\n")
    print(summary(out_model))

    set.seed(42)
    med_result <- mediate(med_model, out_model,
                          treat="info_score", mediator="q24_num",
                          boot=TRUE, sims=500)
    cat("\nMediation analysis results:\n")
    print(summary(med_result))

    med_table <- data.frame(
      Effect = c("ACME (indirect)", "ADE (direct)", "Total", "Prop. mediated"),
      Estimate = c(med_result$d0, med_result$z0, med_result$tau.coef, med_result$n0),
      CI_low   = c(med_result$d0.ci[1], med_result$z0.ci[1],
                   med_result$tau.ci[1], med_result$n0.ci[1]),
      CI_high  = c(med_result$d0.ci[2], med_result$z0.ci[2],
                   med_result$tau.ci[2], med_result$n0.ci[2]),
      p_value  = c(med_result$d0.p, med_result$z0.p,
                   med_result$tau.p, med_result$n0.p)
    )
    qtable(med_table, caption="Mediation Analysis: info_score -> q24 -> satisfaction")

  } else {
    cat("mediation package not available. Using manual Sobel test.\n")

    # Path a: info_score -> q24_num
    fit_a <- lm(q24_num ~ info_score, data=df_complete)
    a <- coef(fit_a)["info_score"]
    se_a <- summary(fit_a)$coefficients["info_score", "Std. Error"]

    # Path b: q24_num -> satisfaction (controlling info_score)
    fit_b <- lm(satisfaction ~ q24_num + info_score, data=df_complete)
    b <- coef(fit_b)["q24_num"]
    se_b <- summary(fit_b)$coefficients["q24_num", "Std. Error"]

    # Sobel test
    ab <- a * b
    se_ab <- sqrt(b^2 * se_a^2 + a^2 * se_b^2)
    z_sobel <- ab / se_ab
    p_sobel <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z_sobel), lower.tail=FALSE)

    # Total effect: info_score -> satisfaction
    fit_c <- lm(satisfaction ~ info_score, data=df_complete)
    c_total <- coef(fit_c)["info_score"]

    # Direct effect
    c_direct <- coef(fit_b)["info_score"]

    cat(sprintf("Path a (info->q24): %.4f (SE=%.4f)\n", a, se_a))
    cat(sprintf("Path b (q24->sat): %.4f (SE=%.4f)\n", b, se_b))
    cat(sprintf("Indirect (a*b): %.4f (SE=%.4f)\n", ab, se_ab))
    cat(sprintf("Sobel Z: %.4f, p=%.4f\n", z_sobel, p_sobel))
    cat(sprintf("Total effect c: %.4f\n", c_total))
    cat(sprintf("Direct effect c': %.4f\n", c_direct))

    sobel_table <- data.frame(
      Path      = c("a (info->q24)", "b (q24->sat, ctrl info)", "Indirect (a*b)",
                    "Direct (c')", "Total (c)"),
      Estimate  = round(c(a, b, ab, c_direct, c_total), 4),
      SE        = round(c(se_a, se_b, se_ab, NA, NA), 4),
      Sobel_Z   = c(NA, NA, round(z_sobel, 4), NA, NA),
      p_value   = c(NA, NA, round(p_sobel, 4), NA, NA)
    )
    qtable(sobel_table, caption="Sobel Mediation Test: info_score -> q24 -> satisfaction")
  }
} else {
  cat("Required variables (info_score, q24_num, satisfaction) not found.\n")
}
```

## 9. Path Diagram

```{r path-diagram}
diagrammer_available <- requireNamespace("DiagrammeR", quietly=TRUE)
ggraph_available     <- requireNamespace("ggraph", quietly=TRUE) &&
                        requireNamespace("igraph", quietly=TRUE)

if (diagrammer_available) {
  library(DiagrammeR)

  # Get path coefficient if available
  path_label <- tryCatch({
    fit_inner <- lm(satisfaction ~ q24_num, data=df_complete)
    b_val <- round(coef(fit_inner)["q24_num"], 3)
    paste0("beta=", b_val)
  }, error=function(e) "beta=?")

  diagram <- grViz(paste0('
    digraph participation_satisfaction {
      graph [layout=dot, rankdir=LR, fontsize=12]
      node [shape=rectangle, style=filled, fontsize=11]

      Q22      [label="Q22\\n(Awareness)", fillcolor="#AED6F1"]
      INFO     [label="Info Score\\n(Information)", fillcolor="#AED6F1"]
      CONSULT  [label="Consult Score\\n(Consultation)", fillcolor="#AED6F1"]
      PART     [label="PARTICIPATION\\n(Latent)", fillcolor="#F9E79F", shape=ellipse]
      Q24      [label="Q24\\n(Part. Level)", fillcolor="#A9DFBF"]
      SAT      [label="SATISFACTION\\n(Outcome)", fillcolor="#FADBD8", shape=ellipse]

      Q22     -> PART [label="w1"]
      INFO    -> PART [label="w2"]
      CONSULT -> PART [label="w3"]
      PART    -> Q24  [label="reflect"]
      Q24     -> SAT  [label="', path_label, '"]
    }
  '))
  print(diagram)

} else if (ggraph_available) {
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)

  nodes <- data.frame(
    name=c("Q22","Info","Consult","PARTICIPATION","Q24","SATISFACTION"),
    type=c("indicator","indicator","indicator","latent","mediator","outcome")
  )
  edges <- data.frame(
    from=c("Q22","Info","Consult","PARTICIPATION","Q24"),
    to  =c("PARTICIPATION","PARTICIPATION","PARTICIPATION","Q24","SATISFACTION")
  )

  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices=nodes, directed=TRUE)

  p_graph <- ggraph(g, layout="sugiyama") +
    geom_edge_link(arrow=arrow(length=unit(3,"mm")), end_cap=circle(3,"mm"),
                   color="steelblue", width=1) +
    geom_node_label(aes(label=name, fill=type), size=3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(indicator="#AED6F1", latent="#F9E79F",
                               mediator="#A9DFBF", outcome="#FADBD8")) +
    labs(title="Path Diagram: Participation -> Satisfaction") +
    theme_void()
  print(p_graph)

} else {
  cat("Neither DiagrammeR nor ggraph/igraph available.\n")
  cat("Path diagram: Q22, Info, Consult -> [PARTICIPATION] -> Q24 -> [SATISFACTION]\n")

  # Fallback: basic ggplot2 diagram
  library(ggplot2)
  nodes_df <- data.frame(
    x=c(1,1,1,3,5,7),
    y=c(4,3,2,3,3,3),
    label=c("Q22","Info","Consult","PART","Q24","SAT"),
    shape=c("rect","rect","rect","ellipse","rect","ellipse")
  )
  edges_df <- data.frame(
    x1=c(1.3,1.3,1.3,3.5,5.3),
    x2=c(2.7,2.7,2.7,4.7,6.7),
    y1=c(4,3,2,3,3),
    y2=c(3,3,3,3,3)
  )
  p_fallback <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data=edges_df, aes(x=x1,y=y1,xend=x2,yend=y2),
                 arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.3,"cm")), color="steelblue", linewidth=1) +
    geom_label(data=nodes_df, aes(x=x, y=y, label=label), size=4,
               fill=c("#AED6F1","#AED6F1","#AED6F1","#F9E79F","#A9DFBF","#FADBD8")) +
    xlim(0.5, 7.5) + ylim(1.5, 4.5) +
    labs(title="Path Diagram: Participation -> Satisfaction") +
    theme_void()
  print(p_fallback)
}
```

## 10. Hypothesis Summary Table

```{r hypothesis-summary}
library(knitr)

hyp_table <- data.frame(
  Hypothesis = c(
    "H1: Higher participation level (Q24) predicts higher satisfaction",
    "H2: Information access (info_score) positively associated with satisfaction",
    "H3: Consultation opportunities (consult_score) positively associated with satisfaction",
    "H4: Ordered trend in satisfaction across Q24 levels (Jonckheere-Terpstra)",
    "H5: Q24 mediates info_score -> satisfaction relationship",
    "H6: Ceiling effect present in satisfaction distribution",
    "H7: Expectation gap: Q24=0 shows lower satisfaction than Q24=2"
  ),
  Test = c(
    "Ordinal logistic regression (polr), Spearman rho",
    "Spearman rho, PLS-SEM outer weight",
    "Spearman rho, PLS-SEM outer weight",
    "Jonckheere-Terpstra Z-test",
    "Sobel test / mediation package",
    "Chi-square vs uniform, proportion at max",
    "One-tailed Mann-Whitney U, Cohen's d"
  ),
  Expected_Direction = c(
    "Positive coefficient, p < .05",
    "Positive rho, p < .05",
    "Positive rho, p < .05",
    "Z > 1.96, p < .05",
    "Significant indirect effect (a*b)",
    "Significant deviation from uniform",
    "Cohen's d > 0.2, p < .05"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

qtable(hyp_table, caption="Hypothesis Summary and Statistical Tests")
```
